title: Shouldn’t customer service AI remember you? Siena to expand 'Agent of Record' combining purchase history with support and social
key_facts: Siena raised $17 million in Series A funding, total $29.7 million
York IE led; Joyance Ventures, Aglaé Ventures and Sierra Ventures participated
Expanding Agent of Record platform for consumer brands
Shopping Agent and Social Agent can answer questions, recommend products and complete purchases in conversations
Hundreds of brands use Siena, including FIGS, SPANX, Comfrt and HexClad
Company says it can automate up to 80% of customer interactions
Funds go to additional autonomous agents and infrastructure
quote_evidence: Siena has raised $17 million in Series A funding to expand its Agent of Record platform for consumer brands, bringing the company’s total funding to $29.7 million.
Across customer deployments, Siena said its technology can automate up to 80% of customer interactions.
why_it_matters_hint: Customer context shared across service, sales and social agents is the pitch.
notes: VentureBeat original (HTTP 429) unreachable; read at Pulse 2.0, which reports the Business Wire release of 6 Oct 2026.
